landing.heroEyebrow: For coaches, sports schools, and athletes
landing.heroTitle2: One place to find a coach.
landing.heroSubtitle: Sessio brings together scheduling, attendance, communication, passes, public profiles, and discovery in one app. Coaches and sports schools stay organized. Athletes can join, book, and stay on top of every session without the WhatsApp chaos.
landing.featuresTitle: Built for the whole coaching business
landing.featuresSubtitle: Daily operations for coaches and schools, plus a better experience for athletes.
landing.feature1Desc: Scheduling, reminders, cancellations, attendance, and passes stay in one place, so coaches spend less time coordinating and more time coaching.
landing.feature2Title: Keep coaches, schools, and athletes aligned
landing.feature2Desc: Everyone gets a clear view of who is coming, what changed, and what is happening next across the calendar.
landing.feature3Desc: Athletes can join with a link, see their schedule, cancel when needed, and stay updated straight from their phone.
landing.feature4Desc: Public coach and school profiles help the right people find you, trust you, and book with confidence.
landing.stepsTitle: Start with the people you already coach
landing.stepsSubtitle: Bring your current athletes into Sessio first. Then use the same system to run sessions better and grow from there.
landing.step1Title: Set up your coaching or school
landing.step1Desc: Add your trainings, locations, schedule, and profile in a way athletes can understand at a glance.
landing.step2Desc: Share a link or code. They join from their phone and instantly get their calendar, reminders, and updates.
landing.step3Desc: Manage communication, attendance, cancellations, and new inquiries without bouncing between WhatsApp, spreadsheets, and memory.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to run coaching in one place?
landing.ctaSubtitle: Start free and give coaches, athletes, and schools a simpler way to stay in sync.
